title: factory-task-path-lease
description: Versioned strict task-scoped path-lease claim (Phase 2C1). A claim is DATA minted by the trusted harness and bound to the exact launch context: campaign ID, selected task ID, attempt, exact HEAD commit, plan digest, policy digest, requested/granted scopes, the exact deny-dominant expanded paths/patterns, issued/deadline bounds, a unique attempt nonce, and a canonical claim digest. No same-UID workspace JSON may self-authorize: only the trusted harness mints claims and only the trusted harness re-validates them against its own context. Replay prevention: any campaign/task/attempt/commit/digest mismatch or expiry fails closed. Security-sensitive leases (a scope marked audit_required) mark audit_required so independent audit is mandatory. Claims carry no free-form commands and never resolve symlinks; Phase 2C2 binds them into the existing signed launch authority and applies exact no-follow path grants.

campaign_id.description: The campaign the claim is bound to.

task_id.description: The selected task ID the claim is bound to.

attempt.description: The attempt number the claim is bound to.

head_commit.description: The exact HEAD commit the claim is bound to.

plan_digest.description: SHA-256 digest of the committed plan the claim is bound to.

policy_digest.description: SHA-256 digest of the committed path-lease policy the claim is bound to.

requested_scopes.description: The scopes requested by the plan task (planner request grants nothing by itself).

granted_scopes.description: The scopes granted by the trusted policy intersection (a subset of requested_scopes).

granted_paths.description: Exact deny-dominant expanded path prefixes granted by the claim.

items.description: Bounded deny-dominant expanded glob patterns granted by the claim (no `**`).

granted_patterns.description: Exact deny-dominant expanded patterns granted by the claim.

issued_at.description: ISO-8601 UTC timestamp when the claim becomes valid.

deadline.description: ISO-8601 UTC timestamp after which the claim expires (must be after issued_at).

nonce.description: Unique per-attempt nonce bound by the claim digest (replay prevention).

audit_required.description: True for security-sensitive leases: independent audit is mandatory.

claim_digest.description: SHA-256 of the canonical claim bytes (all fields except claim_digest).
